name: set-readonly-and-compose
expression: (()=>{const select=document.querySelector('select[aria-label="Assistant permissions"]');if(!select)throw Error('Missing permissions');Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLSelectElement.prototype,'value').set.call(select,'readonly');select.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));const box=document.querySelector('textarea');if(!box)throw Error('Missing composer');Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype,'value').set.call(box,'Roofing QA — read only. Inspect the actual current project evidence and available tools. Can you perform a source-backed pitched-roof takeoff here right now? Use available read-only inspection tools if possible. State the actual source, calibration and roof geometry you observed, name every tool/action you actually executed, and distinguish available operations from missing capabilities. Do not draw, create, import, change the project or fabricate measurements. Finish with a Developer review covering outcome, friction and improvement based on this real attempt.');box.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));return {permission:select.value};})()

name: send-once
expression: new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const check=()=>{const b=document.querySelector('button[aria-label="Send assistant message"]');if(b&&!b.disabled){observer.disconnect();clearTimeout(timer);b.click();resolve('Clicked Send once');}};const observer=new MutationObserver(check);observer.observe(document.body,{subtree:true,attributes:true,childList:true});const timer=setTimeout(()=>{observer.disconnect();reject(Error('Send never enabled'));},5000);check();})
